selected_generation.p: Create brand NEW two-column clean academic diagram contrasting standard attention memory and fused tiled attention. White background, flat solid pale blue/green/peach/red, all text blank. LEFT column: three vertically stacked input strips Q blue TOP, K green MIDDLE, V peach BOTTOM. Q and K each arrows into a single white compute box; this -> large plain red square score materialization -> small white Softmax box -> red square weight materialization. Then weight plus V arrows into second white compute box -> one blue final output strip. V bypass MUST go to second compute, never first. RIGHT column: three vertically stacked compact Q blue TOP, K green MIDDLE, V peach BOTTOM input strips. ALL THREE separate arrows enter ONE large white outlined fused attention computation box. Inside only abstract small tile glyphs; no internal arrows implying K times V, no individual operator circles. The fused compute box has a clear output toward THREE small white running summary boxes in one vertical enclosure (m,s,u), then enclosure -> one blue final output strip. All repeated block iteration shown only as loop arrow from summary enclosure BACK TO fused compute box, whose semantics is continuing exact online normalization. One dashed larger pale green enclosure contains fused compute and summary, to label SRAM later. No full red score or weight matrix on right. Keep generous blank headers/labels and clear arrows. Do NOTdrawletters/digits/symbols, no texture/shadows/gradients/3D.

history.p: FlashAttention exact dense attention memory scheduling compare: conventional route reads QKV in large HBM and writes complete score/attention SIX-by-SIX matrices to HBM then matmulV. Tiled route reads querysmallblock and successive TWO KVtiles from HBM to SRAM, performs scores and online row max/exponent sum/weightedvector sum on SRAM, then cross-tile combines summaries and writes output to HBM without full score matrix. Show two separate memory levels largewhiteHBM container and smallpaleSRAMcontainer, local recurrent summary THREEemptycells m/s/u, arrows tile1then2, one final TWO-cell output for example. Hardwareflat schematic no3D gradient memorychips. NOT summing local softmax probabilities, not approximate sparseattention. Independent composition, reserved explanation blankspaces.
